text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 11, 2023) for 238 Ellerslie Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 11, 2023) for 238 Ellerslie Avenue, Folder Number: 23 197199 PRS 00 IV and in doing so granted an extension of time to June 30, 2024. 2. Advised the appellant to close and make safe with hoarding the garage, in consultation with the Municipal Standards Officer, Municipal Licensing and Standards.
